title: Secretions: sawtooth on expiratory flow
summary: Random 5–20 Hz modulation of airway resistance from mobile secretions produces the irregular sawtooth on expiratory flow and on the F–V loop (Guglielminotti 2000).
objectives: Recognize the sawtooth on expiratory flow and the ragged expiratory limb of the F–V loop.
Suction (remove the injector) and see the loop smooth out.
